task.title: Add semantic execution closure report for sprint/task validation
task.summary: Create a closure report/view that compares approved decision rows to planning tasks, implementation builds, validation reports, and Git proof for task or sprint close review.

goal.outcome: Users and validators can review a compact closure comparison from approved semantic rows through tasks, builds, validation reports, and Git proof without creating a new canonical truth source.
acceptance: A report/view maps approved decision rows to planning_build resolutions, roadmap task ids/sprint ids, implementation_build closure briefs, validation reports, and commit/tree proof when available.
The report highlights missing mappings, deviations, rejected/deferred rows, and remaining risks as validation evidence or follow-up questions.
The report is generated/build-backed and explicitly not a new source of truth.
Task/sprint close validation can cite the report or equivalent structured evidence.
Tests or deterministic fixtures cover row-to-execution mapping and missing-gap display.
non_goals: Do not replace validation reports, implementation builds, roadmap evidence, or Git proof.
Do not require remote publication proof unless the close/publication profile needs it.
Do not build a full analytics dashboard.
Do not perform the system KB component/flow reorganization in this task.
verification: targeted smoke/fixture tests for closure report mapping

loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Implementation validation must not reuse builder thought context and must cite checked content proof.

next_loop.reason: The next gateway must independently validate implementation evidence and cite checked content proof.
